title: Carrier Global to spend more than $600M on campus in Fort Worth, Texas
summary: The new manufacturing and engineering center will expand the company's U.S. production capacity for advanced thermal management systems, Carrier said.

title: JE Dunn tapped for $480M Minneapolis airport upgrade
summary: The Metropolitan Airports Commission selected the general contractor to serve as construction manager at risk for an expansion project at Minneapolis-Saint Paul International Airport.

title: Turner-led JV completes $300M Cleveland higher ed facility
summary: The five-story, 189,000-square-foot research building at Case Western Reserve University includes labs that can adapt to evolving tech and methods across a range of scientific disciplines.</

title: Skanska-Stacy Witbeck JV breaks ground on $2.43B California metro
summary: The joint venture has turned dirt on the 6.7-mile project, designed to ease traffic congestion in the East San Fernando Valley.

title: PCL’s $250M Seattle Amtrak facility arrives on time, under budget
summary: The builder constructed the maintenance hub for Airo trains for $50 million less than the original contract price. Amtrak will use the funds for other rail investments.

title: Suffolk sees hospital construction crunch ahead of California’s earthquake rule
summary: Two Suffolk executives say the state’s 2030 seismic deadline presents multiple challenges on hospital builds, including strained equipment lead times and pricing.

title: Trump tweaks Canada tariffs, removing certain goods while adding others
summary: Plywood and certain packaging materials are among the products that will no longer face the 50% tariff, effective Oct. 30.
